symptom: Generic CodeQL started on every main merge although the workflow analyzes Python and PR admission was already Python-path scoped.
root_cause: push.main had no paths filter, so unrelated control-plane merges consumed a runner.
fix: Mirror the existing Python + workflow-file path scope onto main push.
prevention: Generic specialist security workflows must use the same semantic path scope on PR and main push; a regression test rejects unscoped generic CodeQL main fan-out.
